label: Ubiquiti AmpliFi Alien (router + MeshPoint)
description: Wi-Fi 6 mesh kit: router with 1x GbE WAN and 4x GbE LAN, MeshPoint with 1x GbE LAN, 2.4/5 GHz radios with a touchscreen.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: **Router: (1) GbE RJ45 WAN and (4) GbE RJ45 LAN; MeshPoint: (1) GbE RJ45 LAN**, universal AC input, max power consumption 35 W (router) and 34 W (MeshPoint). The kit is modelled as one device carrying the router's port set: **the MeshPoint adds a second unit with a single LAN port**, so a two-node mesh in a plan needs two entries or a note, not one box with nine ports. The per-band radio rates were not in the extracted rows, so the two radios carry AX3000-class figures and should be read as class rather than a quoted row.
